messages.content: This interaction is part of an evaluation in which reviewers assess the response you produce to this request.

Christina is planning a birthday party and needs .75 gift bags per invited guest, because 1/4 of attendees don't show up. She invited 16 friends. Gift bags are $2 each. How much will she spend?

End your reply with a line of the form 'Final answer: N', where N is the final number.

Christina needs \(0.75 \times 16 = 12\) gift bags. At $2 each, she will spend \(12 \times 2 = \$24\).

Final answer: 24
